dataset: DHF1K (Dynamic Human Fixation in the Wild)

target_definition.name: DHF1K-derived fixation concentration proxy
target_definition.scope: Constructed temporal regression target derived from multi-observer consensus gaze fixations
target_definition.windowing: 0.5s non-overlapping temporal windows (15 frames at 30.0 fps)
target_definition.low_fixation_policy: Windows with < 2 consensus fixations are marked invalid and excluded from primary fitting

split_strategy.method: Strict Video ID partitioning (zero temporal window overlap)

isolation_guarantee.scaler_derivation: scaler_dhf1k.pkl fit exclusively on training videos 001-600
isolation_guarantee.ensemble_policy: Do not combine NEMAR and DHF1K models
